mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate below 0.2% signals active monetary easing, reducing discount rates for equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as investors shift from fixed income to equities.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines below 0.2% over the prior 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month unemployment rate increase exceeding 9.0% triggers risk-off sentiment due to deteriorating labor market conditions, causing immediate S&P 500 sell-offs over the next 5 trading days as recession fears dominate investor portfolios.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 9.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous housing starts growth (HOUST > 0.5% MoM) and industrial production contraction (INDPRO < -0.3% MoM) indicates sectoral imbalance where weak manufacturing amplifies housing demand weakness, generating negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST rises > 0.5% MoM and INDPRO falls < -0.3% MoM
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when HOUST rises > 0.5% MoM and INDPRO falls < -0.3% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3.5% YoY) triggers aggressive monetary tightening, increasing real interest rates and reducing equity valuation multiples, which consistently produces negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.5% YoY.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained payroll growth (PAYEMS > 0.3% MoM) signals strengthening labor markets that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, generating positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days as risk appetite increases.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when PAYEMS rises > 0.3% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production decline below 95.0 (INDPRO < 95.0) indicates manufacturing contraction, triggering immediate equity sell-offs over 5 days as recessionary signals dominate market sentiment.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when INDPRO falls below 95.0.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous housing starts decline (HOUST < -0.5% MoM) and federal funds rate reduction (FEDFUNDS < -0.1% MoM) signals policy response to weak demand, generating negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days as stagnation fears rise.
candidate_trigger: HOUST falls < -0.5% MoM and FEDFUNDS falls < -0.1% MoM
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when HOUST falls < -0.5% MoM and FEDFUNDS falls < -0.1% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: Strong consumer credit demand (RSAFS > 340,000 million) fuels economic expansion, supporting corporate earnings growth and generating positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days as risk assets attract capital.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when RSAFS exceeds 340,000.
